# CitedBy Blog

## About
CitedBy is an Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) platform that helps brands track and improve their visibility in AI-powered search tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity. This blog covers AI visibility, AEO strategy, and how to get your brand recommended by AI.

## Author
Kyle Cupples - Founder of CitedBy and Code Untold. Technical partner at Theanna.

## Topics
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- AI brand visibility and citation tracking
- SEO vs AEO strategy
- ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity optimization
- Schema markup for AI citations
- Structured data for AI search
